steps.action: Rectify a raster drawing plane from known dimensions
human_interpretation: For scale, provide known dimensions on the same plane.
A planar homography rectifies that plane and does not recover object depth.
changes_or_infers: Calculates a plane transform and metric image coordinates from matched points.
checks: Check independent in-plane lengths after rectification.
Record controls, units and transformation.

steps.action: Recognize dimension text with OCR
human_interpretation: Retain original pixels and page transform.
Use OCR output as candidates; resolve glyphs, units, tolerance symbols and feature association against the source image.
changes_or_infers: Produces candidate text strings and numeric dimension values from pixels.
checks: Verify every dimension against the source crop.
Check decimal separator, diameter/radius symbols, tolerance, units and view association.

steps.action: Extract raster edges, lines and contours
human_interpretation: Rectify or record the image transform before measuring extracted pixels.
Separate dimension lines, extension lines, text and object contours by layers or masks.
preserves: Pixel coordinates and candidate segment endpoints
changes_or_infers: Approximates raster strokes as candidate vectors; line/contour algorithms do not classify engineering intent by themselves.
checks: Overlay candidates on source raster.
Measure endpoint gaps and edge displacement in calibrated coordinates.
Retain uncertain or intersecting candidates for review.

steps.action: Extract a model brief from text and dimensions
human_interpretation: Identify each value as supplied, measured, inferred, assumed, or calculated.
Declare units, origin, axes, component boundaries, intended output and source links.
changes_or_infers: Groups explicit requirements into named parameters and geometry constraints.
Does not infer hidden geometry from prose alone.
checks: Every numerical parameter has units and provenance.
Ambiguities affecting geometry are listed separately.

steps.action: Convert raster floor-plan candidates into a wall and opening graph
tools: floor-plan segmentation/vectorization model or manual trace
human_interpretation: Establish plan scale and origin from a known control or explicit drawing dimensions.
Define wall centerline/edge convention and distinguish walls, openings, room labels and annotation.
changes_or_infers: Classifies walls/openings/rooms and infers graph connections from image patterns.
checks: Room/wall graph connectivity
Opening endpoints attach to wall segments
Known lengths and orthogonality
Manual confirmation of ambiguous symbols

steps.action: Raster floor plan to IFC building
human_interpretation: Known plan scale/control lengths, orientation, floor elevation and interpretation rules for walls/openings.
preserves: Original raster, scale transform, interpreted linework, dimension sources and uncertain regions.
changes_or_infers: Pixels interpreted as boundaries and building elements; semantic classification is human/model inference.
checks: Wall thickness, openings, elevations, spatial containment, area/element checks and IFC validation.

steps.action: Library asset intake and rights record
tools: component registry/schema proposal; source license review
human_interpretation: Original source identity and item-level license/terms available or explicitly unknown.
preserves: Original file, URL, retrieved date, hash, attribution, license text/terms and source claims.
changes_or_infers: Normalize metadata; derived conversions become separate assets with lineage.
checks: License status per file; duplicate hash; units/frame; source part number and revision when stated.

steps.action: Place library component in semantic IFC
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
human_interpretation: Component record identifies exact geometry bytes, per-asset terms and placement interfaces; IFC project units and target frame known.
preserves: Existing IFC entity identities, component source provenance and original component bytes.
changes_or_infers: Adds a placed instance and semantic class/properties supported by the selected IFC authoring adapter.
checks: IFC validation; placement and classification; source component mapping and stable identity; rights record attached.

steps.action: Estimate camera poses and sparse structure from overlapping photos
human_interpretation: Static scene or moving objects masked
Overlap and texture sufficient for feature matching
Camera model/preprocessing documented
preserves: Feature and match database, camera model, sparse reconstruction and settings
changes_or_infers: Estimates camera poses and sparse 3D points
Monocular reconstruction scale is arbitrary absent controls/metric sensor
checks: Registered image fraction and component connectivity
Reprojection residual distribution
Camera path and sparse outliers
At least two separated scale controls for local distortion detection

steps.action: Build dense point cloud and mesh from SfM camera solution
human_interpretation: REC-03 sparse camera solution or equivalent calibrated poses
Overlap, exposure and scene masks retained
Scale supplied by control or metric camera data for dimensional use
preserves: Sparse scene, images, camera poses and dense reconstruction settings
changes_or_infers: Estimates dense visible surface and interpolated mesh
Unseen and occluded surfaces are not recovered from images
checks: Image reprojection and dense coverage
Withheld control lengths and independent cloud residuals
Compare mesh-to-cloud distances and disconnected components

steps.action: Register scan to building frame
tools: COLMAP/AliceVision; Open3D/CloudCompare; IFC geometry as reference
human_interpretation: At least one common frame datum and distributed control points/lengths; scan sensor calibration available.
preserves: Raw images/depth, capture settings, raw reconstruction and all transforms.
changes_or_infers: Aligns the scan to IFC coordinates; registration adjusts pose/scale, not building semantics.
checks: Registration residuals and held-out distances; check local regions separately and flag occlusion.

steps.action: IFC to GLB display scene
human_interpretation: Element-to-display mapping and length/orientation conversion are declared.
preserves: IFC source/hash; stable element IDs; source properties in sidecar mapping where GLB cannot retain them.
changes_or_infers: BIM objects become render nodes/meshes; semantic/relationship data may be reduced or remapped.
checks: ID-to-node coverage, bounds, orientation, selected geometry hashes or residuals, output hashes.

steps.action: Author robot assembly from CAD component
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench or explicit CAD assembly authoring

steps.action: Author assembly graph and joint set
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
human_interpretation: Assembly part identities and placements exist; brief states intended motion or records unresolved motion questions.
preserves: Source CAD geometry and measured interface records.
changes_or_infers: Creates explicit graph and joint records; interpretation of motion intent remains reviewable.

steps.action: CAD assembly to articulated robot structure
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench; explicit robot-description authoring; CAD-to-URDF scripts as candidates
human_interpretation: Rigid link groups, parent-child relation, joint type, axis/frame/limits and fixed connections are explicit or reviewed.
preserves: CAD part IDs, geometry, named joint frames, source measurements and assembly transforms.
changes_or_infers: Groups occurrences into links; assembly constraints are mapped to robot joints; inferred joint types remain hypotheses.
checks: Graph connectivity, tree/loop identification, frame transforms, axis signs and limit source.

steps.action: Export mesh assets for MuJoCo
tools: CAD mesh exporter; Blender; Open CASCADE tessellation
human_interpretation: Tessellation settings and mesh local frame/units chosen.
changes_or_infers: Surface geometry becomes triangles; MuJoCo supports OBJ and binary STL; material assignment is separate.
checks: Bounds, scale, normals, topology, source/mesh overlay and referenced geom role.

steps.action: Generate convex collision set
human_interpretation: Input mesh local frame and scale known; collision features/contact regions identified.
preserves: Input visual mesh, source hash, license, decomposition parameters and derived hull set.
changes_or_infers: Nonconvex surface approximated by convex pieces; holes/passages may be filled or altered.
checks: Hull finite bounds; compare envelope/volume; inspect missing passages; simulator contact fixtures.

steps.action: Calculate or import physical mass properties
tools: CAD kernel mass properties; MuJoCo compiler geom inference; measured scale
human_interpretation: Geometry scale/frame and density or measured mass stated; inertia reference frame defined.
preserves: Raw input values, source evidence, units and chosen frame.
changes_or_infers: Computes volume/COM/inertia from B-rep or mesh and density, or assigns measured values.
checks: Mass positive; tensor symmetric/positive-definite and triangle inequalities; compare independent mass where available; confirm mesh watertightness.

steps.action: Author native MJCF simulation model
tools: MuJoCo MJCF XML and mjSpec API
human_interpretation: Consistent units chosen; body tree and element frames explicit; contact/actuation scope defined.
preserves: Editable XML/spec, mesh assets, frame definitions, physical-property provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD components become bodies/geoms; density-based inertial calculation only where explicitly intended.
checks: MJCF schema/parser compile; inertia validity; joints, contact pairs, solver/actuator parameters and asset paths.

steps.action: Robot assembly to URDF package
tools: URDF XML/Xacro authoring; ROS urdf_tutorial; CAD-to-URDF adapter proposal
human_interpretation: Robot link/joint tree defined; mesh units and origins known; mass/inertia records have source and frame.
preserves: Part IDs, joint axes, limits, mesh lineage, mass/inertia provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD links become URDF links; supported tree joints are mapped; CAD history/material layers may be omitted.
checks: Parse URDF; graph tree; positive mass and valid inertia; FK transforms; mesh path resolution and RViz/model consumer load.
